articles.title: Demond Wilson, Lamont on 'Sanford and Son,' Dies at 79
articles.summary: Actor Demond Wilson, famously known for his role as Lamont Sanford in the classic sitcom "Sanford and Son," has passed away at 79 in Palm Springs, California. Wilson's portrayal of Fred Sanford's put-upon son endeared him to millions, making him a beloved figure in television history. His death marks the passing of a significant cultural personality who left a lasting legacy in entertainment.

articles.title: Critics Dubbed Malcolm In The Middle's Central Family 'Dysfunctional' — The Hit Sitcom's Stars Disagree
articles.summary: The popular sitcom 'Malcolm in the Middle' is making a comeback with a revival titled 'Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair,' scheduled to premiere in April 2026 on Hulu and Disney+. The series will reunite key original cast members, including Frankie Muniz as Malcolm and Bryan Cranston, offering fans a return to the beloved Wilkerson family's comedic antics.

articles.title: Native Americans, literally the furthest thing from immigrants, fear deportation amid unprecedented ICE actions
articles.summary: Amidst increased U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) activity in Minneapolis, Shane Mantz, a Choctaw Nation citizen, began carrying his tribal identification card. This action highlights issues of identity and the assertion of tribal citizenship in response to federal immigration operations, suggesting complexities faced by individuals with diverse citizenships during enforcement actions.
